answer: The dermal papilla (Dp) is defined by NDP and SOX2 expression as it forms from the encapsulated base of the dermal condensate (Dc) following HF invagination.
support_quote: Following HF invagination, the Dc becomes encapsulated at its base as the Dp (NDP + , SOX2 + ) 26,28 (Fig. 2c and Extended Data Fig. 3h).
